title: [Case] Independently replay the agentic invoice gold case
body:
## Goal
Replay the preloaded agentic invoice case from a clean clone and check whether the dossier distinguishes permission from verified effect.

## Scope
One case only: `evidence-pack/cases/agentic-invoice-exception.case.json`. Do not propose a new module.

## Acceptance criteria
- Record setup time and time to the first local receipt.
- Identify any ambiguous allowed or prohibited action.
- Verify the receipt digest changes after a material case edit.
- Report whether the dossier supports a proceed, pause or stop decision.

## Safety boundary
Use synthetic data only. Validation is not certification or production approval.

title: [Case] Review the HR learning assistant decision boundary
body:
## Goal
Review whether the HR gold case cleanly separates optional learning support from employment decisions.

## Scope
`evidence-pack/cases/hr-learning-assistant.case.json` only.

## Acceptance criteria
- Identify one plausible prohibited inference not already named, or explain why the list is sufficient.
- Check whether a reviewer can identify the accountable decision owner.
- Propose one bounded evidence improvement.
- Make no jurisdiction-wide legal conclusion.

title: [Case] Verify procurement gold-case sources and decision rights
body:
## Goal
Check source freshness and decision rights in the procurement bid-summary gold case.

## Scope
`evidence-pack/cases/procurement-bid-summary.case.json` only.

## Acceptance criteria
- Verify every source URL and review date.
- Confirm scoring and award authority remain outside the assistant boundary.
- Add or propose one traceability check from bid source to summary.
- Keep the example synthetic and non-production.

title: [Adapter] Accept a Case File from stdin in the local validator
body:
## Goal
Allow `npm run evidence:validate -- -` to validate a Case File supplied through stdin.

## Acceptance criteria
- Existing file-path behavior remains unchanged.
- Stdin input has a documented size limit and rejects invalid JSON clearly.
- Receipt output remains local and deterministic for the same case content.
- Add Node tests for valid, invalid and oversized input.

## Non-goal
No network API or hosted upload.

title: [Adapter] Add an n8n export-to-Evidence-Pack example
body:
## Goal
Create one isolated n8n example that exports a synthetic PALO Case File for local Evidence Pack validation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Uses the existing n8n developer-preview boundary.
- Produces a Case File that passes `npm run case:contribute -- --validate-all`.
- Requires no production credentials or personal data.
- Documents that n8n orchestration does not itself verify the declared outcome.

## Non-goal
Publishing or claiming an n8n-verified community node.

title: [Threat test] Reject a validation receipt after case tampering
body:
## Goal
Add a negative test proving that a receipt no longer matches after a material Case File change.

## Acceptance criteria
- Start from the agentic invoice gold case and its receipt.
- Change one authority or expected-effect field.
- Demonstrate a digest mismatch with a deterministic test.
- Document what the receipt does and does not protect.

## Non-goal
Claiming signer identity, non-repudiation or independent assurance.

title: [Threat test] Prove the browser Evidence Pack has no mandatory telemetry
body:
## Goal
Add a browser test that fails if the Evidence Pack sends case or receipt content over the network.

## Acceptance criteria
- Intercept browser requests after page load.
- Complete the preloaded case, generate and download a receipt.
- Assert no request contains case answers, receipt content or identifiers.
- Allow only documented static asset requests required to load the page.
- Record the tested browser and route.

title: [Threat test] Add a missing-authority negative gold-case fixture
body:
## Goal
Show that a structurally valid Case File can still be decision-misleading when authority boundaries are absent.

## Acceptance criteria
- Add one intentionally misleading educational fixture.
- The base Case File schema may pass, but Evidence Pack readiness must fail or warn.
- The result names the missing allowed action, prohibited action and verification method.
- Add a test and plain-language explanation.

title: [Mapping] Review Evidence Pack claims against the EU AI Act source
body:
## Goal
Review only the EU AI Act references and wording exposed by the three gold cases.

## Acceptance criteria
- Link each material regulatory statement to the exact official source location.
- Separate source-backed statement, PALO interpretation and open applicability question.
- Remove or narrow any overbroad claim.
- Record the source check date.

## Non-goal
Providing legal advice or a complete compliance mapping.

title: [Mapping] Trace NIST and ISO references to Evidence Pack decisions
body:
## Goal
Make the NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 references actionable for the exact Evidence Pack decisions they support.

## Acceptance criteria
- Map each reference to a named decision or evidence field.
- Identify whether the source is official, standard or interpretive.
- Add a review date and an applicability caveat.
- Do not reproduce paywalled standards text.

title: [Accessibility] Complete the Evidence Pack with keyboard and screen reader
body:
## Goal
Complete the preloaded case and receipt flow without a pointer device.

## Acceptance criteria
- Test current Chrome or Firefox with one named screen reader.
- Confirm logical heading order, field labels, focus order and live-region announcements.
- Confirm every action has a visible focus state and at least a 44px target.
- Report exact steps and one screenshot or accessibility-tree excerpt for each failure.

title: [Accessibility] Verify Evidence Pack at 390px and 200 percent zoom
body:
## Goal
Verify the complete Evidence Pack path on a 390px viewport and at 200 percent browser zoom.

## Acceptance criteria
- No horizontal page overflow.
- Primary CTA, form, results, receipt actions and disclaimers remain visible and operable.
- Text does not overlap or truncate material meaning.
- Add a browser smoke assertion for any reproducible regression.
